partition_design.IID: Sort the existing client-pool indices, permute once using NumPy default_rng(iid_partition_seed), split into ten consecutive groups of5370 assigned IDs0..9.
partition_design.evaluation: Existing load_data draws1000 balanced development images/task with each block training seed, identical within paired methods/scenarios. Evaluator is never an aggregation input. Reserved official test split remains unused in this study.
partition_design.failure_policy: A numerical partition-generation failure is preserved; repair implementation under a documented pre-training amendment, without selecting a replacement seed.
partition_design.non-IID: Use prepare_label_skew on the same original client pool with LabelSkewConfig(partition_seed=declared_non_iid_seed,alpha=.5), preserving equal client margins. No rejection/resampling based on observed class distributions or model performance.
partition_design.reserved_sets: Preserve original300 server-reference indices and6000 development-evaluation indices exactly; partition membership is disjoint and covers60000 official training examples.

statistics.estimates: Per-block values, paired mean differences, SD and nominal two-sided95% t intervals with df4 (t*=2.7764451052). Same metrics/scenarios/blocks for a contrast; no pooling IID with non-IID.
statistics.interpretation: Descriptive finite-sample replication. Nominal intervals assume approximately normal independent block differences and can be unstable at n=5. Mark practical findings uncertain when their interval crosses the relevant margin. No individual significance or simultaneous-coverage claim across the table; no post-hoc ranking score.
statistics.memory_contrast: Compare main vs no-restoration on the same stopped/recurring/honest-return episodes; second recurring window15..18 matched across methods. A change between episode1 and2 within one method does not identify a memory effect.
statistics.unit: One paired block per regime; n=5. Clients, rounds, scenarios and shared-method comparisons are not additional independent replicates.

matched_control: mixed_drift_and_attack uses mixed_drift_only_control; other scenarios use clean.

v06_scope.evaluation: Development legitimate-task evaluation; no official test set used.

original_limits: Known MNIST/CNN, fixed alpha=.5/full participation/3-of10 attacks and existing nonadaptive attack strength. The weak Gaussian case cannot establish strong attack resistance. No general concept-drift, cryptographic, novel-algorithm or broad Byzantine guarantee; additional dataset/adaptive-attack claims require a separately declared study.

component_definitions_v03_only.FedReTrust-v03-capped-RFA: Always return the three-step RFA aggregate of the same capped deltas; use RFA weights times original clip scales; no directional final weighting or memory. Main-vs-control tests the combined final weighting and restoration. No-restoration-vs-control isolates directional final weighting relative to capped RFA.
component_definitions_v03_only.FedReTrust-v03-no-clipping: Set every clip scale to1, both for peer-anchor computation and final aggregation; retain evidence, restoration and degeneracy fallback. Implement as explicit control, not an infinite norm_cap rejected by config. Measures clipping throughout the method.
component_definitions_v03_only.FedReTrust-v03-no-restoration: DirectionalConfig(use_restoration=False), all other scalars unchanged; fresh evidence q=e every participating round. Direct test of scalar restoration memory.
